description: GENERIC worktree-policy — Universal baseline transplanted by transplant-bundle (git-worktree-isolation) to .claude/config/worktree-policy.json of target projects. Unlike harness's internal policy (.claude/config/worktree-policy.json which includes harness-specific tier1 paths like .harness/**, output/**), this generic policy marks only cross-project git-ignored runtime directories and settings.json (for hook registration codegen) as Tier 1 (direct edit permitted). 100% Worktree Paradigm remains identical: all other git-tracked assets are Tier 3 (worktree enforced) and blocked by worktree-policy-guard when edited directly on protected branches (including README.md and .claude/config/**). External projects customize tier1 patterns to match their git-ignored output directories and protected_branches to match their default branch name.

tier1_main_allowed.description: Direct Edit/Write permitted on main branch — limited to git-ignored runtime/build artifacts and settings.json (for hook registration codegen). Project owners can customize output paths.

escape_hatch.description: Emergency bypass for urgent hotfixes or when hook/worktree infrastructure itself is broken

_adapt.purpose: External project adaptation guide (the guard does not read this key — guidance only).
_adapt.how: Add your project's git-ignored output directories (refer to .gitignore) to tier1_main_allowed.patterns. Git-tracked source/configuration files (including this policy file itself) remain Tier 3 (worktree enforced) with settings.json as a codegen exception.
_adapt.disable: If worktree isolation is unneeded, simply omit worktree-policy-guard from settings.json/hook-registry.
